contents.text: {"answer":"Recall 24V064000 addresses a front passenger seat weight sensor that can fail to suppress the air bag, allowing unintended deployment during a crash. The owner reports the opposite problem: no airbags deployed with either impact. That is why the recall describes a different failure from the one reported here.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"The front passenger seat weight sensor may crack and short circuit, failing to suppress the air bag as intended."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"An air bag that deploys unintentionally during a crash"},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11633527","quote":"Zero  airbags were deployed with either impact."}]}
